title: Layer-Resolved Four-Compartment Finite Element Modeling of Ketoconazole Transport through Porcine Skin from Free and Lecithin-Zein Nanoparticle-Based Formulations
description: Code, source-derived digitized inputs, locked calibration outputs, verification tests, sensitivity diagnostics, and figure assets supporting a sampling-aware four-compartment finite element model of ketoconazole transport in porcine skin. Experimental values not explicitly reported by the source are approximate figure digitizations; model agreement reflects calibration rather than independent validation. The manuscript and supplementary document are not part of this software deposit. Source experiment: Zhang et al., International Journal of Pharmaceutics 590 (2020), 119894, doi:10.1016/j.ijpharm.2020.119894.
